principle: Preserve the submitted benchmark, architecture and accepted analyses; add only evidence needed to answer the seven remaining reviewer concerns.

new_analysis_batches.name: measured_training_and_paired_uncertainty
new_analysis_batches.data_policy: Use the identical twelve measured buildings, preprocessing and 2016/2017 split. Full eligible training pool and 2016-only learning curves/checkpoint decisions. The 2017 holdout was already reported in R1 and is not a new untouched confirmation set.

new_analysis_batches.name: chronological_calibration_and_supervised_control
new_analysis_batches.data_policy: Preserve archived forecast predictions and fault labels. Retain60/40 primary chronology; report50/50 and70/30 and raw-history-disjoint sensitivities. No held-out threshold or hyperparameter selection.

new_analysis_batches.name: complete_pipeline_comparison_and_replay_audit
new_analysis_batches.data_policy: Canonical PSNN12, PSNNcommon11, persistencecommon11 and standaloneGRUcommon11; each detector fitted to its own residuals. Same held-out rows and prospective replay policy. Preserve unfavorable comparisons.

publication_claim_policy: Separate interface specification, empirical findings and retained implementation choices.
Do not claim necessary PSNN, firing probability or dual optimizer, or predictive/economic/safety superiority without supporting new evidence.
Describe measured evaluation as later-year temporal forecasting after retraining on the same buildings.
Describe supervisory evidence as prospective replay and distinguish action counts from alarm flags.
Preserve frozen-data reproducibility while identifying unavailable historical benchmark-generation and MOA-search source accurately.
deliverables: Clean R2 manuscript DOCX and PDF
R2 manuscript with every inserted/replaced word highlighted yellow relative to the uploaded R1 DOCX, plus PDF
Point-by-point R2 response DOCX and PDF
Updated supplementary evidence DOCX and PDF
Resubmission cover letter DOCX and PDF
Analysis reproducibility ZIP with pinned inputs, protocols, scripts, predictions, checkpoints, figures, verifiers and checksums
Consolidated submission ZIP containing final documents and the separately hashed analysis ZIP
archive_policy: Do not claim the R2 package is already published under the old version DOI. Cite the exact supplementary analysis ZIP filename, version and SHA256. Exclude final R2 manuscripts from that analysis ZIP to prevent a circular archive checksum; include them in the consolidated submission ZIP.
integrity_policy: No invented measurements, source code, DOIs, author approvals, human review claims, physical feedback, comfort validation or protective gating outcomes. Programmatic figures must derive from identified data; disclose AI assistance according to publisher policy.
